The valid Gate D phase completed one full 1920x1080 frame as 360
uncompressed 11,520-byte transfers. Each transfer ended with a 256-byte short
packet.

KDE then changed to 1280x720. The service completed six full frames as 1,080
uncompressed 10,240-byte transfers. Those lengths are exactly 20 high-speed
512-byte packets. Every bulk submit had transfer flags zero, and the capture
contains no zero-length bulk submit. Thus the aligned transfers did not rely
on URB_ZERO_PACKET or a separate ZLP URB.

All 1,440 bulk URBs completed with status zero and their full submitted
length. Usbmon and the Pi service journal agree on the payload count.
